pages.text: The rarest thing a Bog Toad can give up is a $(item)Bogfang$(). Set in a blade with a strip of Boghide and a stick, it makes a weapon that does little itself and a great deal through what it carries.

pages.title: Bogfang Blade
pages.text: Lighter than an iron sword, with a longer life.

pages.title: The Rot
pages.text: Every hit infects a living target with $(thing)Bogrot$() for 45 seconds. This works on almost anything that can rot: zombies, skeletons, animals, players and the creatures of other mods. Only elementals, slimes and the toads' own kin are spared.$(br2)A normal hit shows no flourish. The rot just sets in.

pages.title: Rupture
pages.text: Land three $(thing)critical hits$() on the same infected target and the rot ruptures. The Bogrot is consumed, and all the damage it had left to deal lands at once.$(br2)A rupture needs eight seconds to recover before it can happen again.

pages.title: Bogburst
pages.text: The $(thing)Bogburst$() enchantment makes a rupture spread. Nearby hostile creatures catch the rot: within 5 blocks for 15 seconds at level I, within 7 blocks for 25 seconds at level II.$(br2)Ogres in the blast are infected like any other target. Sometimes that is the point.
